title: Trimmer Line 2.4 mm × 100 m – 5-Sided for String Trimmer & Edge Trimmer
descriptionHtml:
Thin trimmer line that keeps snapping?

Cheap round line wears down, jams and snaps in the middle of the job – and you have to stop, feed out new line and start over again and again. What should take twenty minutes turns into half a morning of irritation.

5-sided line that cuts – not tears

The five-sided profile gives sharp edges that cut through grass and weeds instead of tearing them off. 2.4 mm thickness and 100 meters on the spool mean fewer interruptions and a whole season of trimming.

Features

  • 5-sided profile – cuts more effectively than round line.
  • 2.4 mm thickness – handles thick grass and weeds.
  • 100 meters on the spool – lasts the whole season.
  • Fits most string trimmers and edge trimmers.
  • Hard-wearing orange – easy to see when refilling.

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
